title: Vendor Delay Remedies on Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Delay days.** The delay of a Ridgeline Special Order Services order is the number of calendar days by which the estimated ready date — or the ready date, once the item is ready — is later than the promised ready date; it is 0 when not later.

**1. Entitlement.** When the delay is above the program's vendor delay threshold, the customer may choose one delay remedy, never both.

**2. First remedy — cancellation.** The first remedy is to cancel with no cancellation fee, from status placed or vendor confirmed, and from in production as well where the program allows a delay cancellation in production; the cancellation reason is vendor delay and every payment is refunded.

**3. Second remedy — delay credit.** The second remedy is to keep the order and receive a delay credit; a program whose delay credit percentage is 0 offers no delay credit.

*Retired clause.* The clause that set the delay credit as follows is **no longer in force**: "receive a delay credit of the delay credit percentage of the order total, capped at the delay credit maximum, posted once as a delay credit". It has been superseded by the current delay credit basis.

**4. Limits.** A customer who took the delay credit may not later cancel fee-free for the same delay, and a delay caused by the customer's own change to the order earns no remedy.

**5. Shipped orders.** An order already shipped earns only the delay credit.

## Threshold boundary (hypothetical Windows and Exterior Doors order, threshold 21 days, promised ready date 13 April)

| Estimated ready date | Delay days | Remedy available |
|---|---|---|
| 4 May | 21 | no — not above the threshold |
| 5 May | 22 | yes — one of the two remedies |
| 10 April | 0 | no |

## Remedy by order status (delay above the threshold, delay not caused by the customer)

| Order status | Fee-free cancellation | Delay credit |
|---|---|---|
| placed or vendor confirmed | yes | yes, where the program's delay credit percentage is above 0 |
| in production | yes, only where the program allows a delay cancellation in production | yes, where the program's delay credit percentage is above 0 |
| shipped | no | yes, where the program's delay credit percentage is above 0 |

## Points of judgement

- A customer who has taken the delay credit and later asks to cancel free for the same delay is not entitled to the fee-free cancellation.
- A delay that follows the customer's own change to the order earns neither remedy.

superseded_clauses: receive a delay credit of delay_credit_pct percent of the order total, capped at delay_credit_max_usd, posted once as credit_type delay_credit
